decisions.reason: The cobot loading system builds directly on the established machining offer and fits the firm's automation strategy, and with growing industry turnover and an expanding firm there is enough slack and no performance shortfall that would trigger problemistic search.
The dual-table loading system is a low-risk extension of the core machine portfolio that supports customer productivity, so it is unlikely to fall below aspiration levels within one year of launch.

Although it is distant from the core offer, the dispensing machine is a presented flagship with its own page and a Red Dot award, which signals early success against aspirations, and the firm's slack lets it carry the product while its market results remain uncertain.
